summary: Maintainers need to understand the full architecture: protocol system, backend registry, settings pipeline, transform infrastructure, and where invariants live. Key concerns are protocol conformance, backend registration order, settings→adapter dispatch, and safe lazy SDK imports.

concepts.name: Protocol system
recommended_docs: 8 granular protocols. Backends implement à la carte. Facade checks instanceof at call time. Protocol conformance validated by tests/protocol_alignment/.

concepts.name: Backend registry and registration order
recommended_docs: _backend_registry dict; @register_storage_backend; auto-triggered by `from . import storage_backends` in package root. clear_registry() is test-only.

concepts.name: Settings → adapter dispatch
recommended_docs: StorageProfile.__adapter__ class var → adapter module → to_*_kwargs(). Lazy SDK imports in adapters prevent ImportError for absent optional deps.

concepts.name: Spec and descriptor system
recommended_docs: StorageDescriptor fields (sdk_package, handler_module, handler_class, supports_streaming, supports_multipart, read_only). STORAGE_REGISTRY for spec lookup. Renamed from descriptor→spec in 26.5.0.

concepts.name: Stream transform internals
recommended_docs: StreamTransform.wrap/unwrap symmetry. Pipeline apply_read (outer→inner), apply_write (inner→outer reversed). _PairedStream in facade.py closes both wrapper and source on close().

concepts.name: Suffix inference
recommended_docs: SUFFIX_TRANSFORMS dict. Parsing stops at first unknown suffix. Write-side inference is intentionally absent. GPG requires instance; raises ValueError without one.

concepts.name: Backend implementations
recommended_docs: Local is the reference implementation. S3 dispatches by FLAVOR in adapter. HTTP backend (evolving) implements read/write/metadata only; list/copy/delete unsupported.

concepts.name: Exception hierarchies
recommended_docs: Two separate hierarchies: main exceptions.py (public, 6 classes) and settings/exceptions.py (16 classes, internal). Main hierarchy only is re-exported from package root.

concepts.name: CalVer versioning
recommended_docs: YY.MM.MICRO format. 0=RC, 1=production, 2+=patches. Deprecation warnings target 26.6.0 removal (get_descriptor, *_DESCRIPTOR aliases).

documentation_plan: Architecture overview: facade → registry → backend (with protocol checks)
